column1: # The four plans: the site's form and the CLI's --plan. visibility and release follow from the plan; extended says
# whether r-cmd-check-extended starts on (off for a private internal package, to save minutes); first_checklist is the
# checklist the next steps point to.
# qc: the QC checklist (lists/checklists.tsv, stage qc_stage in settings.tsv) starts on; it is offered for private plans.
